rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`.

The requirement's MUST is that the description states when to use the skill in terms of the user's task. The description does this. It says to use the skill "during design sessions and before changing code, tests, or requirement text in a project that tracks requirements with Habeas". It also says to use it when the user asks for a feature, bug fix, CLI flag, test, dependency bump, or wording tweak, even if the user never says "requirement". These are all user-task terms, not internal mechanics.

The description also says "Not for moving code or requirements between files or outline nodes; use habeas-refactor. For validation findings, use habeas-evidence." The requirement permits this with its MAY, so it is not a gap.

No violation queries were listed, so there are no violation matches to judge.
